theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (x : Eucl N) (W : Set (Eucl N)), 0 < ρ → x ∈ latticeFace ρ F₀ → IsOpen W → x ∈ W → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) ⊆ W ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ 0 < latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n)
